Do not panic when session contains a tool call without a response

Normally, all tool calls within a saved session should have a response, but there are legitimate reasons for the response to be missing. This can occur if the user canceled the call or there was an error of some sort during the rollout. We shouldn't panic in this case.

This is a partial fix for #7990
